title: Thermoarcanic Gloves
summary: Fire damage gives the wearer Heat.

fields.Arcane Ashes: Gain 2 turns of Heat once per attack when you deal Fire damage. Separate Scorching Ray hits can trigger it multiple times.
fields.Heat: Take 1d4 Fire at turn start. Maximum 7 turns. Heat Convergence consumes the remaining Heat on the next qualifying Fire damage to add 1 Fire per remaining turn.
fields.Acquisition: Kansif, at the cultist camp or after the Harper ambush.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
